title: Extremal States of Multipartite Quantum Spin Systems
summary: We consider two quantum spin models on $k$-partite graphs. The system is assumed to be invariant under all permutations within any of the $k$ sets. In the limit of infinitely many particles, the Gibbs state is described as a mixture of independent spins due to a version of the Quantum de Finetti theorem. First, we study a spin-1/2 antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model and identify its three phases.
